test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 10 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: At which of the following railway stations of South Africa was Gandhiji thrown out of a train after refusing to leave the first-class compartment?
solution:
The correct answer is **Pietermaritzburg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Point__**

 
• The primary train station for the city of** Pietermaritzburg, South Africa**, is Pietermaritzburg Railway Station.
 
• **M.K. Gandhi was pulled forcibly **from a whites-only carriage on a train to Pietermaritzburg on June 7, 1893
